hypotheses.G1_layer1_human_families_beat_random_gro: At rank 256, Layer-1 human-family target projection exceeds the 99th percentile of size-matched random regroupings by at least 0.02 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G2_layer0_human_families_beat_random_gro: At rank 256, Layer-0 human-family target projection exceeds the 99th percentile of size-matched random regroupings by at least 0.02 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G3_semantic_grouping_emerges_by_layer1: The true-minus-null-median rank-256 advantage is at least 0.02 larger at Layer 1 than Layer 0 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G4_layer1_human_families_beat_global: At rank 256, Layer-1 human-family target projection exceeds the all-other-pairs global bank by at least 0.02 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G5_family_advantage_transfers_ood: The true-minus-null-median rank-256 advantage is positive on TinyStories at both layers.
hypotheses.G6_semantic_grouping_survives_decoder_no: With decoder-norm-normalized discovery ranking, the true rank-256 family projection exceeds the 95th percentile random-group projection on both corpora and layers.
hypotheses.G7_pair_similarity_oracle_beats_human_fa: At rank 256, a target-pair-informed nearest-pair grouping exceeds the human-family grouping by at least 0.03 in at least one corpus at each layer.
